build_llama_generator: build a Llama generator from a checkpoint directory and tokenizer path for code completion
run_text_completion: run text completion on code prompts using the Llama generator with temperature and top_p sampling
run_code_completion_cli: run the code completion CLI tool with a checkpoint dir and tokenizer path via fire
configure_generation_params: configure generation parameters like temperature, top_p, max_seq_len, and max_batch_size for the Llama generator
generate_code_continuation: generate natural code continuation for partial Python function prompts using the Llama model
